sec15-F12.text: Avoid lane changes on the freeway, signal well ahead of any you make, use the mirrors and look back first, never stop unless absolutely unavoidable, never slow unnecessarily, and never follow too closely, because freeway rear-end collisions are common and usually involve several vehicles.

sec15-F18.text: A tire blowout is the sudden release of air that collapses a tire and can cause loss of control, it most often results from poor tire care, so check pressure and condition every month.
